summary: Complete 6-Stage Architectural & UX Implementation Plan for Forge Academia: (1) Shared Capability & Evidence Model + Event-Driven Forge Buddy Policy, (2) Verified Project-to-Playground Milestone Loop, (3) 10/10 Decluttered Lesson Player ('One Screen = One Thought', 2-row header, zero duplicate text/raw markdown, event-driven bottom Buddy pill, no audio or unsolicited IDE drawer), (4) 4-Tier Guided Dashboard & Exact Activity-Level Resume, (5) Validated Interview & Feedback Loop, and (6) Module Capability & Lesson Closure Evidence Polish.
